title: A closer look at CAE Flight Operations Solutions at NBAA 2022
body_markdown: What are CAE Flight Operations Solutions? Frederic Morais, CAE Flight Services' Head of Strategic Growth, talks about CAE's ecosystem of Flight Operations Solutions and how they can benefit #bizav operators. Learn more on CAE's presence at NBAA:[https://www.cae.com/nbaa-2022/](https://www.cae.com/nbaa-2022/)
